title: Transfer learning for transient NOx, PN and THC emission prediction of non-road diesel engines based on NRTC experiments
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00321K, Paper
Wen Zeng, Haiyi Wang, Feng Zhou, Jianqin Fu, Tao Wen, Kainan Yuan, Xiongbo Duan
This study introduces a novel task transfer learning framework for predicting transient emissions (NOx, PN, and THC) in non-road diesel engines.
